text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The crowd is going absolutely wild<n>today! Clearly
they're ready to see<n>what will unfold on the stage
of the<n>Japanese Oaks this year!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Even I'm starting to feel<n>nervous! Break a
leg, Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I really hope Dober can run at her<n>very best
today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Stop fussing over me so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: To be honest, yeah. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not so bad if I pretend I'm just<n>shaking with
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretending it's excitement. It<n>feels more
reassuring that way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer... You believe in me, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you believe in me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Do you still believe in my running and<n>my strength?
choice_data_list: You're the strongest racer in the world.
You're the strongest racer in the world.

text_block_list.text: Do you still believe in my running and<n>my strength?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's ridiculous! Why do you<n>always say such
baseless things?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You always exaggerate so<n>much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'll accept your silly<n>exaggeration at face
value for today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Your words make me feel a lot more<n>confident
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm off.
